sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL OF PETITION The counsel appearing for the petitioners humbly submits that as per the instructions obtained by the petitioners are seeking leave of this Hon'ble court to withdraw the above petition.
Since the petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 have filed mutual consent petition under section 13B of Hindu marriage act in MC No. 246/2025 on the file of Principal family judge, Udupi.
The family court at Udupi vide order dated: 12.12.2025 have allowed the petition filed by 1st petitioner and 2nd respondent.

Moreover the 2nd respondent clearly admit in her affidavit evidence and in examination chief filed in MC No.
246/2025 stating that complaint lodged under section 498A, 504, 506 R/w 34 of IPC and section 3 and 4 of DP act are Bonafide mistake as the contents of complaint are not true against the petitioners herein.
Hence the same may kindly be taken on record in the interest of justice."
NC: 2026:KHC:5168 HC-KAR
In terms of memo, the petition is disposed as withdrawn.
